threshold: Frozen calibration threshold; no evaluation retuning or below-threshold fallback
quota: Upper bound only; reduce the IF quota to fit baseline reservations, slot limits and minute limits
baseline_remainder: Existing baseline ordering, no IF reranking of baseline tasks
mandatory: Keep frozen baseline-selected cao_nhat and nontransaction work; additional pending hard work precedes IF after reference-day reservations
candidate: Evaluation-only IF score >= frozen threshold; transaction and document never appeared in observed baseline scope before cutoff
document_key: company plus invoice_id, else journal_document_id, else transaction_id
case_unit: One highest-scored available lead per document, one IF review per document
dedup: Cumulative baseline membership/context/evidence and invoice source scopes block rediscovery
subsequent_baseline: Later baseline review is charged separately, never auto-completed by an IF lead
causality: Only today's counterfactual baseline selections reserve today's capacity; future reference selections never gate current decisions
delay_interpretation: Zero additional calendar days relative to the frozen baseline review day; does not promise zero absolute waiting time or correct an already-late baseline SLA
outcomes: Independent outcomes and actual review minutes remain unavailable
